# Hook and tool names

The tool names, hook events, environment variables, and contract details each harness uses, generated from the shipped catalogs in `pkg/harness-compilation/toolpolicy` and `pkg/harness-compilation/hookpolicy`. Regenerate with `make catalog-docs`; `make catalog-check` fails when this page is stale.

## Shared tool concepts

| Concept | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `access.request` | Ask the user for filesystem access. |
| `ask.user` | Ask the user a question. |
| `file.delete` | Delete a file. |
| `file.edit` | Modify an existing file in place, including patch application. |
| `file.list` | List a directory. |
| `file.read` | Read file contents. |
| `file.write` | Create or overwrite a whole file. |
| `mcp.call` | Call a tool on an MCP server. |
| `mcp.read` | Read an MCP resource. |
| `mcp.servers` | List configured MCP servers. |
| `mcp.tools` | List tools on MCP servers. |
| `notebook.edit` | Modify notebook cells. |
| `notebook.read` | Read notebook cells. |
| `plan.enter` | Enter plan mode. |
| `plan.exit` | Leave plan mode. |
| `search.glob` | Find files by path pattern. |
| `search.grep` | Search file contents. |
| `shell` | Run a shell command. |
| `shell.powershell` | Run a PowerShell command. |
| `shell.session` | Poll, feed, or stop an already running shell session. |
| `skill` | Load a skill. |
| `subagent` | Start a subagent. |
| `subagent.read` | Read a running subagent's output. |
| `todo` | Maintain the agent's task list. |
| `web.fetch` | Fetch a URL. |
| `web.search` | Run a web search. |

## Canonical hook events

| Canonical event | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `Notification` | When the harness sends a user notification. |
| `PermissionRequest` | When a tool call needs a permission decision. |
| `PostCompact` | After context compaction. |
| `PostToolUse` | After a tool call succeeds. |
| `PostToolUseFailure` | After a tool call fails. |
| `PreCompact` | Before context compaction. |
| `PreToolUse` | Before a tool call runs; can block it. |
| `SessionEnd` | When a session ends. |
| `SessionStart` | When a session starts or resumes. |
| `Stop` | When the main agent is about to finish its turn; can request continuation. |
| `SubagentStart` | When a subagent starts. |
| `SubagentStop` | When a subagent finishes. |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | After the user submits a prompt, before the model sees it. |
